skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced vocabulary through various topics covered in class and additional reading materials.
Read to identify themes, main ideas, and read with purpose to find specific details.
Identify sequences of events, arguments for and against, levels of certainty, cause-effect relationships, problems-solutions, references, and how ideas connect.
Summarize, infer, or judge the contents of reading materials, understand the author's purpose, attitude, figurative language, analysis, and evaluation of evidence.

Write various types of essays in an academic style, including introduction paragraphs, body paragraphs with main ideas and supporting details, conclusion paragraphs, and logical organization of ideas.
Identify and correct errors in writing.
Work collaboratively in groups, pairs, and discussions when solving reading and writing exercises as required by instructors.
Demonstrate self-study, practice, and self-assessment skills to develop autonomy in the learning process.
Work independently and responsibly to complete tasks related to improving reading and writing skills as required by instructors.
Express and defend personal opinions when writing essays in an academic style.
